item.title: Nintendo Collector Loses More Than 860 NES Games Worth Up to $100,000 in Massive Home Burglary
item.description: A Nintendo collector in Washington says thieves stole more than 860 NES games from his home, wiping out a collection he spent nearly 40 years assembling and valued at between $50,000 and $100,000.

item.title: Banjo-Tooie Coming to Nintendo Switch Online Expansion Pack
item.description: Banjo-Tooie is back. Yep, the bear and bird duo are flying (or waddling) their way to Nintendo Switch Online on October 25, 2024.

item.title: Super Mario Party Jamboree ROM Leaked Before Launch
item.description: With less than a week until Super Mario Party Jamboree hits the shelves, there’s already a storm brewing online.
